Perhaps you envision a fully-equipped, built-in outdoor kitchen, or a stunning outdoor living area complete with a fireplace and architectural features resting against a beautiful landscape. Whatever your dream, the trusted professionals of Custom Concept Pools can make it a reality. Custom Concept Pools specializes in first class premium quality design and construction for residential home-owners and custom builders. We offer a single source for custom pools and spas, outdoor kitchens, living spaces, landscaping/irrigation and pool remodeling. With a business built on the cornerstones of quality, honesty and integrity, it is not surprising that Custom Concept Pools has grown solely by word of mouth. Our motto is, “The customer is the business and the business is the customer”, and we never lose sight of this. There’s a lot of talk about great customer service, quality and a hands-on approach in the industry, but Custom Concept Pools delivers what it promises. Custom Pools Custom Concept Pools offers complete design and construction of your pool. Your imagination is the only limit! See your new pool in a 3D design before we even begin the project. Pool Remodels Custom Concept Pools offers complete design and construction of your pool. Your imagination is the only limit! See your new pool in a 3D design before we even begin the project. Outdoor Kitchens Custom Concept Pools offers complete design and construction of your pool. Your imagination is the only limit! See your new pool in a 3D design before we even begin the project. Don't Just Take Our Word For It. See What Some Of Our Clients Have To Say: "Custom Concept Pools was one of our five pool consults we had while making our choice of who to choose to build our dream pool. After meeting with Jerry and Paul, there was no question in my mind that they were the guys to do the job. The ideas they had to enhance not only our pool but our entire backyard, including a covered patio and outdoor kitchen, blew our minds! It was well worth the wait in finding these guys. The project went by smoothly and quick. My husband was out of town most of the time they were doing the pool, Jerry was like a second father, taking care of everything and watching over my family and my home. I was shocked at how soon our pool was filled with water! But my biggest surprise was the dedication that Jerry had to my project. Jerry and or Paul were over at my home everyday overseeing every step of the project every step of the way. Even the day that the pool was filling with water, my children went out to play in the half filled pool . I sent Jerry a photo of this fun occasion to let him know how excited my kids were, with in 10 minutes he was in our backyard sharing this fun memory! Jerry has become a part of our family as well as his wife and grand kids. Even still years after our pool is completed and being enjoyed by our family, I still feel like I can call him for advice about pool issues! I highly recommend Custom Concept Pools for any outdoor adventure you would like to create. We just adore Jerry and Paul, they will transform your outdoor living space into a resort setting and working with someone you trust is amazing!" Kara & Dave Griser "Thank you a million times over for the best building experience ever! You guys are amazing..... Not only were y'all the easiest to work with from start of to finish.... But your continued support of any question, concern or confusion that we have is answered almost immediately! Scott and I have been beyond impressed with y'all and would recommend Custom Concept Pools to anyone who is looking to build a pool. " Forgot to mention, Scott has said numerous times... "This pool is worth every penny and more than we spent!" Scott & Robyn Ruth "We had our pool, landscaping and outdoor kitchen done by Custom Concept Pools back in May 2008 and we are so glad we chose Jerry and Paul to do the work. Due to easement restrictions in our backyard, we knew the design process would present a challenge to the company we selected. Due to these challenges, the larger custom pool companies in the area were hesitant to even spend the time to create a design and quote. Jerry and Paul's creative ideas and unmatched customer service, along with reasonable pricing made the entire experience wonderful. The installation process went very smoothly and quickly. We have referred several of our friends to Custom Concept Pools which is a testament to how much we value them. Every day we spend enjoying our pool and outdoor kitchen reminds us of the great decision we made to go with Jerry and Paul." Jody & Christie Mathews "Carla and I would like to thank you for the personal dedication and professionalism you exhibited in the building of our beautiful custom pool. There was not a day that went by, in which you were not here in person, overseeing the completion of this project. From the very beginning of working on the design, to the filling of the pool, your dedication and attention to detail, certainly shows in the final product. Carla and I could not be more pleased, feeling that we now have our own piece of paradise. We are so very proud of our pool. We would be happy to provide verbal references by phone. Feel free to give our phone number to any future clients. This pool is something that Carla and I will enjoy for many years. Thanks again for your hard work and dedication.” Carla & Kyle Hackney "We are really glad that we chose you to build our pool. We appreciated the professionalism and friendship that we experienced through the process. We are really happy with our pool, waterfall, etc. It’s just beautiful and relaxing. We truly appreciate your one-on-one daily contact and follow-through. Thank you for helping us create a stunning backyard that we thoroughly enjoy." Greg & Tina Schroeder Designation "Custom Concept Pools exceeded our expectations for our pool project. The professionalism and “one-on-one” was outstanding! We thoroughly enjoy our new oasis. Thank you for an enjoyable pool building project; 3 weeks from start to end was phenomenal!" Mike & Michelle Bahar "My wife and I want to take this opportunity to tell you how much we love our new pool! We were amazed at the amount of personal attention you constantly devoted to the project. From the initial design phase all the way through the final phases of construction, you provided a very pleasant experience. Since our pool project was so large and somewhat complicated, we knew to expect little problems along the way. It was the manner in which you resolved these minor problems that impressed us the most. Whether it was a last-minute design change we sprung on you, or a simple oversight that needed attention, your rapid response was responsible for completing our pool ahead of schedule, on-budget and 100% to our satisfaction. Your dedication to maintaining the highest level of quality is very evident and is greatly appreciated. We are so glad we chose you as our pool builder. We confidently recommend you to all our friends and family who are considering a new pool. Thanks again for everything you’ve done. We wish you and your company continued success!" data.summary: The review profile is highly suspicious. An established 18-year-old pool contractor with only one blank, 5-star review and no presence on any other review platform indicates a severe lack of authentic customer feedback, strongly suggesting the business is not actively reviewed by real customers or has manipulated its online presence.
fake_signals: Only 1 total review for an 18-year-old business
No reviews on any other platform (Angi, Houzz, Yelp, Trustpilot)
BBB profile shows zero complaints or customer reviews
The single Google review contains no text or details
Lack of any negative or neutral feedback
authentic_signals: None identified. The single review is devoid of content, and there is no substantive customer feedback to analyze.
data.discrepancy_explanation: Extremely high rating (5.0) with only 1 review across two Google listings for an 18-year-old business is a major red flag. The BBB A+ rating is based on accreditation factors, not customer feedback, and has no reviews or complaints listed, which is unusual for a long-standing company.
